taskDescription: Arrange the steps of HIV entry and integration into a host cell in the correct sequence.
paragraphs: gp120 binds to the CD4 receptor on the host T-helper lymphocyte
gp120 undergoes conformational change and binds the co-receptor (CCR5 or CXCR4)
gp41 mediates fusion of the viral envelope with the host cell membrane
Reverse transcriptase converts viral RNA into double-stranded proviral DNA in the cytoplasm
Integrase inserts the proviral DNA into the host chromosome, forming a latent reservoir
